# Enable ssh connectivity
touch /boot/firmware/ssh

# get module details (serial number => TARGET_DEVICE_SERIAL)
cat /proc/cpuinfo

# check total RAM
free -h

# check eMMC and NVMe sizes
lsblk

# create first-boot cript
sudo cat << EOF > "/boot/firmware/user-data"
#cloud-config
hostname: "cm5-${TARGET_DEVICE_SERIAL}"
create_hostname_file: true
manage_etc_hosts: true

package_update: false
package_upgrade: false

rpi:
  interfaces:
    spi: true
    i2c: true
    serial: true

timezone: Europe/London
keyboard:
  model: pc105
  layout: "gb"

users:
  - name: ansible
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    shell: /bin/bash
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-rsa  izzyonstage@hotmail.com

chpasswd:
  expire: false
  users:
  - {name: ansible, password: D00wn33rg.1182, type: text}
ssh_pwauth: true

runcmd:
  - systemctl restart avahi-daemon
EOF

# reset system to re-run first-boot script
sudo cloud-init clean --logs && sudo reboot
